_meta.name: bootstrap_resample
_meta.description: Bootstrap resampling: REG_OLS with resample bootstrap replaces the analytical standard errors, p-values and intervals with estimates from 200 with-replacement resamples (bootstrap_iters 200, rng_seed 42 pins them); the coefficients do not move. Sibling of 09_jackknife.json (leave-one-out). bootstrap_requested / bootstrap_succeeded echo the replicates. Resampling buffers the request.
